Conservation Biology - Biodiversity Metrics, Fragmentation, Rewilding

sections.text: Conservation biology is a crisis discipline — it applies ecological science to prevent species extinction and maintain functional ecosystems. It combines population ecology, biogeography, evolutionary biology, and social science. The scale of the crisis is unprecedented: background extinction rate ~1 species/million species/year; current rate ~100–1000× background.
